puget.title: Puget

Keeping what's reachable, turning off the light
If nothing points to you anymore
You can walk out the door

Everything can wait a beat

You and me the only two still walking round
Picking every dropped thing off the ground
Stop the world, just for a while
Let me catch my breath, let me find my smile
Everything can wait a beat
Stop the world beneath my feet
And when it starts again
Will you still be here then
Stop the world, just for a while
Let me catch my breath, let me find my smile
Everything can wait a beat
Stop the world beneath my feet

Zip code first, then the rest, I guess
Year, month, day, so the sorting's clean
Every file in line like a marching team
You can call it stubborn, I call it clear
Loudest part up front so the back can hear

Whoever speaks first gets the floor

Say it out loud like a rehearsed verse
